<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:id="@+id/main" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/background_gray" tools:context=".HomeActivity">
<ScrollView android:id="@+id/homeScroll" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="0dp" android:clipToPadding="false" android:paddingBottom="160dp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/bottomNav" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:padding="16dp">
<!-- Header --> <ImageView android:id="@+id/ivAvatar" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_person" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvWelcome" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="@string/home_welcome" android:textSize="12sp" app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/ivAvatar" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="@id/ivAvatar" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvUserName" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="Halo, " android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="@id/tvWelcome" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvWelcome" />
<ImageView android:id="@+id/btnSettings" android:layout_width="24dp" android:layout_height="24dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_settings" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="@id/ivAvatar" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="@id/ivAvatar" />
<!-- Wallet Card Stack --> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout android:id="@+id/walletStack" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/ivAvatar">
<View android:id="@+id/cardBackPink" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="180dp" android:layout_marginStart="24dp" android:layout_marginEnd="24dp" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_home_card" android:backgroundTint="@color/chart_pink" android:rotation="-4" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />
<View android:id="@+id/cardBackBlue" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="180dp" android:layout_marginStart="16dp" android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" android:layout_marginTop="6dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_home_card" android:backgroundTint="@color/chart_blue" android:rotation="-2" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout android:id="@+id/cardWallet" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/bg_home_card" android:elevation="8dp" android:padding="24dp" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvLimitTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="@string/home_limit_title" android:textColor="@color/white" android:textSize="12sp" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvBalance" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="6dp" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="Rp5.000.000,00" android:textColor="@color/white" android:textSize="24sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvLimitTitle" />
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/llIn" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:layout_marginTop="16dp" android:layout_marginEnd="8dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_bottom_nav" android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_light" android:gravity="center" android:orientation="horizontal" android:paddingHorizontal="14dp" app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@+id/llOut" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvBalance">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="v Rp5.000.000" android:textColor="@color/white" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="bold" /> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/llOut" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_bottom_nav" android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_light" android:gravity="center" android:orientation="horizontal" android:paddingHorizontal="14dp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="@id/llIn" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toEndOf="@id/llIn" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="@id/llIn">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="^ Rp0.0" android:textColor="@color/white" android:textSize="12sp" android:textStyle="bold" /> </LinearLayout>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout> </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
<!-- Spending Stats --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvStatsTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="@string/home_spending_stats" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/walletStack" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvDateRange" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="(1 Mar - 31 Mar)" android:textSize="12sp" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvStatsTitle" />
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/cardStatsRow" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="16dp" android:orientation="horizontal" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvDateRange">
<androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:id="@+id/cardDonut" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" app:cardCornerRadius="16dp" app:cardElevation="4dp" app:cardUseCompatPadding="true">
<FrameLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="200dp" android:padding="16dp">
<View android:layout_width="140dp" android:layout_height="140dp" android:layout_gravity="center" android:background="@drawable/bg_circle_button" android:backgroundTint="@color/light_gray" />
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="center" android:gravity="center" android:orientation="vertical">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/home_total_spending" android:textSize="10sp" />
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Rp 106,258" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textStyle="bold" /> </LinearLayout> </FrameLayout> </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
<androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:id="@+id/cardCategory" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:layout_weight="1" app:cardCornerRadius="16dp" app:cardElevation="4dp" app:cardUseCompatPadding="true">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/home_category" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"> <View android:layout_width="10dp" android:layout_height="10dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_circle_button" android:backgroundTint="@color/green" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" android:text="Restoran" android:textSize="10sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"> <View android:layout_width="10dp" android:layout_height="10dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_circle_button" android:backgroundTint="@color/chart_green_light" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" android:text="Keperluan Sekolah" android:textSize="10sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"> <View android:layout_width="10dp" android:layout_height="10dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_circle_button" android:backgroundTint="@color/chart_cyan" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" android:text="Kesehatan" android:textSize="10sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp"> <View android:layout_width="10dp" android:layout_height="10dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_circle_button" android:backgroundTint="@color/gray" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" android:text="Liburan" android:textSize="10sp" /> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="center_vertical"> <View android:layout_width="10dp" android:layout_height="10dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_circle_button" android:backgroundTint="@color/light_gray" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="8dp" android:text="Kosmetik" android:textSize="10sp" /> </LinearLayout> </LinearLayout> </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView> </LinearLayout>
<!-- Transactions --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvTransTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="@string/home_last_transactions" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/cardStatsRow" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvSeeMore" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="@string/home_see_more" android:textColor="@color/text_blue" android:textSize="12sp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="@id/tvTransTitle" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="@id/tvTransTitle" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvTransDate" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="Minggu, 8 Maret 2026" android:textSize="12sp" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvTransTitle" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btnFilter" style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.OutlinedButton" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="32dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:text="@string/home_filter" android:textAllCaps="false" android:textSize="12sp" app:cornerRadius="16dp" app:strokeColor="@color/light_gray" app:strokeWidth="1dp" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvTransDate" />
<!-- Transaction Items (Placeholders) --> <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:id="@+id/itemTrans1" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" app:cardCornerRadius="16dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/btnFilter"> <RelativeLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:padding="12dp"> <ImageView android:id="@+id/ivIcon1" android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_launcher_foreground" android:background="@color/chart_cyan" /> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvName1" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_toEndOf="@id/ivIcon1" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:text="Spotify Prem" android:textStyle="bold" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_toEndOf="@id/ivIcon1" android:layout_below="@id/tvName1" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:text="Belanja • 25 Jan 2026" android:textSize="10sp" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentEnd="true" android:layout_centerVertical="true" android:text="-Rp150.000" android:textColor="@color/trans_red" android:textStyle="bold" /> </RelativeLayout> </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
<androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:id="@+id/itemTrans2" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" app:cardCornerRadius="16dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/itemTrans1"> <RelativeLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:padding="12dp"> <ImageView android:id="@+id/ivIcon2" android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_launcher_foreground" android:background="@color/chart_blue" /> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvName2" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_toEndOf="@id/ivIcon2" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:text="Servis Laptop" android:textStyle="bold" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_toEndOf="@id/ivIcon2" android:layout_below="@id/tvName2" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:text="Servis • 25 Jan 2021" android:textColor="@color/text_blue" android:textSize="10sp" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentEnd="true" android:layout_centerVertical="true" android:text="-Rp340.000" android:textColor="@color/trans_red" android:textStyle="bold" /> </RelativeLayout> </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
<androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:id="@+id/itemTrans3" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" app:cardCornerRadius="16dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/itemTrans2"> <RelativeLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:padding="12dp"> <ImageView android:id="@+id/ivIcon3" android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_launcher_foreground" android:background="@color/chart_pink" /> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvName3" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_toEndOf="@id/ivIcon3" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:text="Eki Shinta" android:textStyle="bold" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_toEndOf="@id/ivIcon3" android:layout_below="@id/tvName3" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:text="Transfer • 25 Jan 2021" android:textColor="@color/text_blue" android:textSize="10sp" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentEnd="true" android:layout_centerVertical="true" android:text="-Rp340.000" android:textColor="@color/trans_red" android:textStyle="bold" /> </RelativeLayout> </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
<!-- Savings Goals --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvGoalsTitle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="@string/home_savings_goals" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="16sp" android:textStyle="bold" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/itemTrans3" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvManageGoals" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/inter" android:text="@string/home_manage_goals" android:textColor="@color/text_blue" android:textSize="12sp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="@id/tvGoalsTitle" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="@id/tvGoalsTitle" />
<androidx.cardview.widget.CardView android:id="@+id/cardGoals" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" app:cardCornerRadius="16dp" app:cardElevation="2dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvGoalsTitle"> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="16dp">
<RelativeLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content"> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Pergi Umroh" android:textSize="12sp" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentEnd="true" android:text="Rp6.000.000" android:textSize="12sp" /> </RelativeLayout> <ProgressBar style="@style/Widget.AppCompat.ProgressBar.Horizontal" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="8dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:progress="60" android:progressTint="@color/green" />
<RelativeLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp"> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Travelling ke Labuan Bajo" android:textSize="12sp" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentEnd="true" android:text="Rp500.000" android:textSize="12sp" /> </RelativeLayout> <ProgressBar style="@style/Widget.AppCompat.ProgressBar.Horizontal" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="8dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:progress="35" android:progressTint="@color/green" />
<RelativeLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp"> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Beli Iphone" android:textSize="12sp" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentEnd="true" android:text="Rp4.000.000" android:textSize="12sp" /> </RelativeLayout> <ProgressBar style="@style/Widget.AppCompat.ProgressBar.Horizontal" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="8dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:progress="50" android:progressTint="@color/green" />
<RelativeLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp"> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Nikah" android:textSize="12sp" /> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentEnd="true" android:text="Rp3.000.000" android:textSize="12sp" /> </RelativeLayout> <ProgressBar style="@style/Widget.AppCompat.ProgressBar.Horizontal" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="8dp" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:progress="55" android:progressTint="@color/green" />
</LinearLayout> </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout> </ScrollView>
<!-- Bottom Nav --> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout android:id="@+id/bottomNav" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="72dp" android:layout_margin="16dp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent">
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/navPill" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="64dp" android:layout_marginEnd="12dp" android:background="@drawable/bg_bottom_nav" android:elevation="8dp" android:gravity="center" android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="12dp" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/fabAdd" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">
<ImageView android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:padding="12dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_home" android:tint="@color/white" />
<ImageView android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:padding="12dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_history" android:tint="@color/white" />
<ImageView android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:padding="12dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_target" android:tint="@color/white" />
<ImageView android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:padding="12dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_admin" android:tint="@color/white" /> </LinearLayout>
<com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton android:id="@+id/fabAdd" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:src="@drawable/ic_add" app:backgroundTint="@color/primary_medium" app:fabSize="normal" app:tint="@color/white" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" />
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
